TAL_SOUND_CARRY_VOICE.why: Sends a brief message to a creature, bell or prepared anchor you can see (or, spending 1 CP and a minute of Concentration, a mile away). Talking between fights is not a fight effect: no damage, no condition, nothing the table rolls.

TAL_SOUND_THOUSAND_PACE_CALL.why: The same message, sent up to 10 miles to a familiar creature, place, bell or sect token after a minute of Concentration. Communication, not a fight effect.

TAL_SOUND_VOICE_HEARD_ACROSS_THE_MOUNTAI.why: A 10-minute ritual that carries a message across up to 100 miles to a bell, shrine, gate or anchor. Long-range communication, not teleportation, divination or mind-reading.

TAL_SOUND_READ_THE_VIBRATION.why: Makes a Sound Check and learns one thing about a place, object or creature (hollow, cracked, resonant, haunted, recently moved through). An investigation for the Game Master to answer; it grants no combat benefit and reveals no hidden creature automatically.

TAL_SOUND_SOUL_ECHO_HEARING.why: Makes a Sound Check to learn whether a creature is possessed, oath-bound or haunted, or whether a Silence is natural, magical or domain-based. A question for the Game Master, not a fight effect.

TAL_SOUND_TREMOR_LISTENING.why: Its only fight number is typed (Read the Vibration reaches 120 feet along the surface you touch). What you detect through that surface -- movement, impacts, doors, machinery -- is the Game Master's answer, and it grants no Blindsight.

TAL_SOUND_SOUND_INITIATION.why: Choose your expression (voice, bell, drum, strings, flute, whistle, footfall, chant, bone resonance) when you learn Sound. A descriptive choice until a variant uses it; its minor harmless sounds (a hum, a thrown voice, a dampened noise) change nothing at the table.

TAL_SOUND_CARRYING_BELL.why: You prepare one small instrument during a Long Rest and carry it; the typed part is the Read the Vibration Advantage. Doubling Carry Voice's reach for a creature familiar with the sound, and using Resonant Note quietly once per short rest, are the Game Master's calls.

TAL_SOUND_BELL_OF_CLARITY.why: The repeated saving throw is typed (a chosen creature repeats one against Charmed, Frightened or Deafened). What counts as magical confusion, possession pressure or a voice-borne effect, and whether such an effect came with a saving throw at all, is a ruling the table cannot check.

TAL_SOUND_BELL_THAT_BREAKS_THE_FORMATION.why: Its 8d10 Thunder damage, its ignoring Resistance and hardness, and the roll against a placed object's Armor Class are typed. What a major Formation Anchor, artifact or Domain core does about a crack is the Game Master's ruling; the table never destroys one.

TAL_SOUND_MOUNTAIN_CRACKING_BELL.why: The Constitution save, 10d8 Thunder damage, Prone, Resonance and double damage to objects in the area are typed. Cracking a cliff, breaching a wall or suppressing a Formation function is a structural ruling for the Game Master; it never destroys an artifact, a Domain or immortal architecture.

TAL_SOUND_SHATTER_THE_CHANT.why: Its Sound Check against the triggering creature's Save DC and the Resonance on a margin of five are typed, as is Advantage for one target's saving throw. Halving an already-declared effect's range, protecting yourself from it and cancelling a command-only effect need a ruling: the table has no seam for changing an effect that exists.

TAL_SOUND_COUNTER_CHANT.why: Its Sound Check (opposed by the creature's own check or Save DC) and the chosen rider are typed. Whether the disrupted sound carried words that matter, and whether a harmless message can still carry 30 feet, is the Game Master's read of the effect.

TAL_SOUND_RESONANCE_MIRROR.why: The Wisdom save, the Disadvantage-or-Advantage fallback and the free 10-foot move are typed. Sending the triggering attack to your echo needs an echo the table can target, which it cannot make.

TAL_SOUND_ECHO_DECOY.why: The decoy is a real creature at the table (Armor Class 10, 1 Hit Point, gone when damaged or touched). What a creature learns by examining it instead of hitting it, and whether its senses expose it, is the Game Master's call.

TAL_SOUND_STEAL_VOICE.why: The Constitution save, the silencing and the Disadvantage on its next Charisma check are typed. Whether the target even has a voice is a creature fact the table does not track.

TAL_SOUND_SILENT_STEP_BETWEEN_NOTES.why: The silent 5-foot step and the creature that loses its chance to react are typed. Stepping 10 feet instead while you stand in your own Dampen Sound area is the Game Master's read of where you are standing.

TAL_SOUND_STONE_BELL_PROPAGATION.why: Its +30 feet against a target on the same surface is typed. Choosing a point on a struck structure for a harmless sound, a warning bell or a Carry Voice message to come from is flavour the table does not place.

TAL_SOUND_WORLD_RINGING_NOTE.why: The save, 8d8 Thunder damage, Resonance, the lost Reaction and full damage to objects in the area are typed. Where on a struck structure a warning tone comes from, and what Total Cover still blocks, are the Game Master's calls.

TAL_SOUND_WORLD_SPLITTING_SCREAM.why: The save, 12d10 Thunder damage, Deafened, the lost Reaction and double damage to objects are typed. The visible crack or tremor trail left in the ground is scenery, not a rule the table enforces.

tianxia.talent.sound.the_first_sound_bef.why: Its three modes are typed (16d10 Thunder or Psychic with Deafened and Stunned, 20d10 against a placed structure, and the 60-foot field that swallows hostile Thunder and silences hostile voices). Which ordinary function a surviving structure loses, and whether an artifact, Domain or immortal formation cracks at all, is the Game Master's ruling.
